question: A new dimension added by Amartya Sen to food security is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**entitlements**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Entitlements** is the new dimension added by Amartya Sen to the concept of food security.
 
• Amartya Sen's entitlement approach emphasizes that food security is not just about the availability of food but also about individuals' ability to access food.
 
• This approach considers the various means through which people can acquire food, such as production, trade, labor, and transfers.
 
• Sen's theory highlights that food insecurity can occur even when there is ample food supply if people lack the means to access it.
 
• The focus on entitlements shifts the discussion from mere food supply to broader socio-economic factors that influence food access and distribution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Amartya Sen is a renowned economist and philosopher who has made significant contributions to welfare economics and social justice.
 
• He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences in 1998 for his work in welfare economics.
 
• Sen's entitlement approach has been influential in shaping policies and programs aimed at addressing food security and poverty.
 
• It underscores the importance of ensuring that all individuals have the necessary resources and opportunities to access food.
 
• Sen’s work has had a profound impact on the understanding of food security and has led to more comprehensive strategies to tackle hunger and malnutrition.
